transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in today because I’ve barely been sleeping lately. It started after a warehouse inspection I had to do for work. I just... I lie in bed replaying bits of it over and over. And when I finally do manage to drift off, I wake up completely sweaty and wide awake. It feels like I’m right back near that blast.
How long ago did the blast occur?
It was about a week ago. That's when the inspection was, and... when the explosion happened. So this has all been going on since then.
Since the explosion, have you felt unusually on guard or easily startled?

Yes, very much so. It's actually been really noticeable at work. Every time a printer jams, or a door slams, or someone just comes up behind my desk, I jump like something terrible is happening. And then... it just takes me several minutes to actually settle down again.
Since the explosion, have you been avoiding anything that reminds you of what happened?

Yeah, I have. At work, I've been completely avoiding the file for that warehouse. And, um, I've actually been letting any calls about our industrial accounts just go straight to voicemail. Honestly, even just the thought of opening those emails makes my stomach drop, so I've just been staying away from all of it.
Since the explosion, have you had moments when you felt detached from yourself or as though what was happening around you wasn’t quite real?

No, I don't think so. I mean, everything feels very real... almost too real, honestly. I haven't really felt disconnected from myself or like things are a dream or anything like that. It's more just that I'm constantly on edge.
How long have you been having trouble sleeping?
It's been going on for about a week now. Basically, ever since that warehouse inspection... you know, when the explosion happened. That's when it started.
Before the explosion, were you already having ongoing problems with sleep?
No, not at all. I mean, I've always slept pretty well before this. I didn't have any issues with it until everything happened last week.
